newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AWB sells 6,000 tonnes in ninth wheat tender.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AWB sells 6,000 tonnes in ninth wheat tender.

text.p: The Australian Wheat Board (AWB) sold 6,000 tonnes of wheat in its ninth tender bid, with Australian Hard 13 percent protein (AH13) wheat selling at between A$218.00 and A$223.00 a tonne.
The AWB also sold 2,000 tonnes of SHAR wheat delivery Geelong at A$217.50 a tonne. SHAR is a high-protein hard Victorian wheat.
The two sales of AH13 wheat involved 2,000 tonnes at A$218.00, delivery Geelong, and 2,000 tonnes at A$223.00, delivery Fremantle.
Bids were submitted for a total of 30,000 tonnes in four zones. All were for new crop wheat.

Closing date for the next tender is November 6.
NOTE - ASW: Australian Standard White; APW: Australian Premium White; AH: Australian Hard; APH: Australian Prime Hard; SHAR is a high protein hard Victorian wheat.
